tagline: Hawaii-based regional bank providing comprehensive financial services
hero_kpi_rationale: This KPI is BOH's 'wow' factor as it reflects credit risk management in an uncertain economic environment, a critical aspect for a financial institution. It demonstrates the company's ability to anticipate and provision for potential losses.

kpis.name: Reserve for Credit Losses
kpis.explanation: Amount set aside to cover potential losses on loans and other credit commitments.
kpis.description: This reserve is calculated according to specific accounting standards (ASC 326) and considers past events, current conditions, and economic forecasts to estimate future losses. The reserve includes the allowance for loan and lease losses and the reserve for unfunded lending commitments.
kpis.signal: Indicates prudence in the face of economic risks.

kpis.name: Share Repurchases
kpis.explanation: Total number of shares repurchased by the company during a given period.
kpis.description: In the fourth quarter of 2025, 77,155 shares were repurchased (including 608 shares acquired from employees for tax withholding). The repurchase program, launched in July 2001 and increased by $100 million in January 2023, has no fixed expiration date.
kpis.signal: Return of capital to shareholders and reduction in shares outstanding.

kpis.name: Total Share Repurchases Value
kpis.explanation: Total monetary value of shares repurchased by the company.
kpis.description: Represents the total value of shares repurchased under the repurchase program in the fourth quarter of 2025. This value reflects open market purchases of 76,547 shares at an average price of $65.33 per share.

risks.title: Credit Losses
risks.score_rationale: The company uses estimates to determine credit losses, which may be subject to uncertainties and errors. Economic conditions and assumptions used in these estimates can have a significant impact on financial results.

risks.title: Interest Rate Fluctuations
risks.score_rationale: Fluctuations in interest rates can impact the value of the company's assets and liabilities, as well as its financial performance.

risks.title: Market Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to market risks, particularly due to its securities investments and lending activities.

risks.title: Tax Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to complex tax rules and regulations, which may lead to uncertainties and errors in determining its tax obligations.

risks.title: Operational Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to operational risks, particularly due to its internal systems and processes.

risks.title: Liquidity Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company must manage its cash flows to meet its financial obligations and maintain liquidity.

risks.title: Reputation Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to reputation risks, particularly due to its activities and relationships with customers and partners.

ai_positioning.summary: BOH does not mention artificial intelligence, machine learning, or related technologies in its 10-K filing.
